pick_reading_list.description: Keeps the first five Microsoft Learn search results, each reduced to its title and link.

output_fields.description: First five results in search order

reading_list.description: First five results in search order

read_repo_wiki_outline.description: Calls the deepwiki read_wiki_structure tool for the input repository and returns the wiki outline as text (a string, as the tool returns it).

search_microsoft_learn.description: Searches Microsoft Learn with the topic as the query and returns the decoded search result, an object whose results array holds each match's title and link.

write_digest.description: Builds the markdown digest with a Reading list section of linked titles and a Repo outline section holding the wiki outline as returned.

output_fields.description: Markdown document with Reading list and Repo outline sections

digest.description: Markdown document with Reading list and Repo outline sections
